lines: The Apex compensation plan is built on two ladders — Technology, and Insurance. You can climb one, or both.
And it's free to start. Zero dollars to begin — no paywall, no catch.
Let's walk through exactly how you get paid on each.
The Technology ladder is open to everyone — licensed or not. You earn by putting Apex's A.I. tools in the hands of businesses.
First, one quick term: Business Volume, or B.V.
For every product, Apex designates a Business Volume — and that's the amount your commission is based on.
You get paid two ways. First, a commission on the B.V. of every sale you personally make.
Second, override income — a share that comes back to you as the team you build makes sales too.
So your income grows two ways at once: what you sell, and what your team sells.
You're paid on what you sell — and paid again as the team you build sells too.
Your override income grows with your rank. There are nine ranks — Starter to Elite.
Higher ranks unlock deeper override levels — from one level at Starter, all the way to seven levels deep at the top.
Level one always pays thirty percent of the override pool — your enrollment override, on everyone you personally bring in.
And every rank you reach pays a one-time bonus — more than ninety-three thousand dollars in bonuses along the way.
One rule to earn overrides: produce at least fifty points of personal volume a month. Sell a little, stay qualified.
The second ladder is Insurance — for licensed agents. It's a completely separate business.
You earn fifty to ninety percent of the first-year premium on every policy you write.
And it's paid directly by A-rated carriers — straight to you.
You own the book of business. Your clients, your renewals, your asset.
Seven ranks, from Pre-Associate at fifty percent, up to M.G.A. at ninety. You climb by production and quality.
Build a team, and you earn generational overrides on their production — six generations deep.
Here's what that looks like. Recruit five agents. They each recruit three — a team of twenty, each writing five thousand a month.
Your override income? Around seven thousand five hundred dollars a month — on top of your own commissions. Ninety thousand a year.
Produce consistently and you earn a weekly production bonus — one to four percent on top.
Build a shop as an M.G.A., and you earn quarterly recruiting bonuses — up to six thousand dollars a quarter.
Here's what makes Apex different. The two ladders run on completely separate trees — no mixing, fully compliant.
But one person can run both at once.
Lead with technology. Build an insurance career. Or stack them — two income streams, one team.
Every rank is permanent. Once you earn it, you keep it. And there's no ceiling on either ladder.
Two ladders. One opportunity. This is the Apex compensation plan. Start free, at reach the apex dot net.
